# `balance_action_reversal`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Compensating ledger entry of a cancelled top-up or adjustment; at most one per action.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Reversed action; its history id. The primary key allows one reversal. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Owning prepaid account. |
| `currency` | `text` | no |  | Account currency. |
| `amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | Exact opposite of the reversed amount (ledger entry). |
| `operator` | `text` | no |  | Operator who cancelled the action. |
| `reversed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Injected-clock reversal instant. |
